_comment: Supplier and fulfillment-partner directory. ship_to_vegas_days = typical door-to-door range for a Las Vegas customer. Pricing fields are planning estimates where marked; 3PL rates are industry-typical because Vegas 3PLs quote privately — confirm before contracting.

suppliers.name: AliExpress (direct)
suppliers.cost_profile: Lowest unit cost; per-order China shipping; no platform fee
suppliers.best_for: Product validation orders and samples before committing capital
suppliers.risks: 15-30 day worst case; holiday blackouts (CNY, Golden Week) add 1-2 weeks; dispute-heavy

suppliers.name: CJ Dropshipping
suppliers.cost_profile: No subscription; product + shipping per order; US-warehouse SKUs cost ~40-60% more than China-direct
suppliers.best_for: Scaling validated products with US-warehouse inventory before committing to bulk import
suppliers.risks: Only a fraction of catalog is pre-stocked in US warehouses — must filter 'US Warehouse' explicitly; China-sourced items still 7-22 days

suppliers.name: Zendrop
suppliers.cost_profile: Free/Pro ($49/mo) plans; US-stocked SKUs at premium unit cost
suppliers.best_for: Shopify-native automation; US 3-5 business day shipping on stocked SKUs
suppliers.risks: US estimates assume SKU actually stocked stateside; China fallback is 10-15 business days

suppliers.name: Spocket
suppliers.cost_profile: $39-99/mo subscription; higher unit costs, domestic speed
suppliers.best_for: US-origin versions of pet, golf, wellness SKUs without holding inventory
suppliers.risks: Thinner selection of viral/trend SKUs; margin compression vs China sourcing

suppliers.name: Alibaba (bulk import)
suppliers.cost_profile: Lowest landed unit cost at 200-1000 MOQ; sea freight ~20-35 days or air 5-10 days to Vegas 3PL; this is the buy that powers the local-inventory play
suppliers.best_for: Bulk acquisition of proven winners for Vegas 3PL / FBA stocking
suppliers.risks: Inventory capital at risk; QC inspection required (use pre-shipment inspection ~$100-300); tariff exposure

suppliers.name: Printify / Printful (print-on-demand)
suppliers.cost_profile: No inventory; per-unit print cost; strong for personalized designs
suppliers.best_for: Personalized bachelorette, golf-gift, and pet SKUs (personalization was 2026's strongest demand signal)
suppliers.risks: 2-4 day production before shipping; lower margins than bulk

suppliers.name: Your Logistics Corp (North Las Vegas 3PL)
suppliers.cost_profile: Pick/pack + storage + postage; quotes private — model at ~$3.25/order pick-pack, ~$25/pallet/mo (industry-typical, verify)
suppliers.best_for: West-coast eCommerce fulfillment, Amazon prep, returns processing

suppliers.name: Black Mountain Fulfillment (Las Vegas 3PL)
suppliers.cost_profile: Advertises same-day eCommerce fulfillment; quotes private
suppliers.best_for: Same-day local fulfillment — the core of the fast-Vegas wedge
suppliers.risks: Verify same-day cutoffs and courier coverage of Strip hotels

suppliers.name: Red Stag Fulfillment (Las Vegas)
suppliers.cost_profile: Premium accuracy SLAs; strong for heavy/bulky (poker sets, floats)
suppliers.best_for: Heavy/high-value SKUs needing low shrink and damage rates

suppliers.name: ShipNetwork (Las Vegas)
suppliers.cost_profile: National network with LV node; quotes private
suppliers.best_for: Scaling beyond Vegas while keeping LV as the western node

suppliers.name: Amazon FBA (LAS2/LAS6/LAS7 + SNV1 same-day)
suppliers.cost_profile: 15% typical referral (8% PC/electronics) + size-tier fulfillment fee + 3.5% fuel surcharge (from 2026-04-17) + storage + inbound placement
suppliers.best_for: Prime badge demand capture once a SKU is proven; SNV1 enables same-day in Vegas
suppliers.risks: Fee stack ~30-40% of price; commingling/clone competition; account suspension risk
